correctness.rationale: The claimed FO modal validity is shown both ways. SNF converts each unary pp definition on cyclic groups into divisibility and torsion constraints; prime-adic exponents yield a finite exceptional-prime profile and a bounded small-cardinality exception for each Baur–Monk index predicate. The constructed finite directed poset has an explicit surjective p-morphism and preserves all FO atomic interpretations, so every Grz.2 theorem transfers. Definable p-torsion coordinates pull Boolean-cube countermodels back to finite cyclic groups, and finite-Boolean completeness gives the reverse inclusion. Independent finite checks of exact quotient lifting and modal axioms returned VERIFY_OK. The finite checker is not an infinite certificate.

value.rationale: This determines an exact modal logic for an infinite natural subclass and proves that the first-order restriction forces a strict strengthening of the known all-abelian S4.2 result. The explicit uniform finite directed quotient for arbitrary FO group sentences explains the semantic mechanism and is potentially reusable for other classes of structures. This is a complete classification, not a numerical toy computation.
